tool_schemas.name: delete_issue
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified issue in the Jira connection context and returns the deleted issue record (or a deletion acknowledgement) with its local status updated to "deleted". Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id does not match the required format or issue_key is missing/invalid; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue key does not exist in this connection, and raises CONFLICT if the issue is already deleted/archived and cannot be deleted again.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key to delete (e.g., PROJ-123).

tool_schemas.name: get_issues
tool_schemas.description: Lists issues for the given project_key in the specified connection, optionally including subtasks, and returns a paged result set filtered by the provided fields (status, issue_type_id, assignee_account_id, reporter_account_id, parent_issue_key) and sorted by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: pass cursor from the previous page to fetch the next page; limit controls page size (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enums/ranges or incompatible filters (e.g., parent_issue_key provided when include_subtasks is false), UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible, and NOT_FOUND if the project key does not exist in this connection.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

project_key.description: Project key to fetch issues for (e.g., PROJ).

include_subtasks.description: Whether to include subtasks in the results.

status.description: Filter issues by local cached status.

issue_type_id.description: Filter issues by Jira issue type id.

assignee_account_id.description: Filter issues by assignee Jira accountId.

reporter_account_id.description: Filter issues by reporter Jira accountId.

parent_issue_key.description: Filter to subtasks of the given parent issue key.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return.

tool_schemas.name: update_issue
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing issue’s editable fields (summary, description, assignee/reporter accountId, parent_issue_key, and/or fields_json) within the given connection and returns the updated issue record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are malformed (including invalid connection_id format) or if no updatable fields are provided, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if the issue_key does not exist in this connection, and raises CONFLICT if the issue is deleted/archived or if the requested parent change is not allowed (for example, setting a parent on a non-subtask issue type).

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key to update (e.g., PROJ-123).

assignee_account_id.description: Set the assignee by Jira accountId.

reporter_account_id.description: Set the reporter by Jira accountId.

parent_issue_key.description: Set/change the parent issue key (for subtasks).

fields_json.description: Arbitrary Jira fields payload to apply (mirrors Jira 'fields' object).

tool_schemas.name: list_fields
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Jira field metadata available to this connection and returns a cursor-paged collection filtered by status and ordered by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: supply cursor to continue listing; limit controls page size (1–500). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/order/limit values and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of fields to return.

tool_schemas.name: list_issue_types
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Jira issue type metadata available to this connection and returns a cursor-paged collection filtered by status and ordered by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: supply cursor to continue listing; limit controls page size (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/order/limit values and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

status.description: Filter issue types by metadata status.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of issue types to return.

tool_schemas.name: list_link_types
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Jira issue link type metadata available to this connection and returns a cursor-paged collection filtered by status and ordered by sort/order. Pagination is cursor-based: supply cursor to continue listing; limit controls page size (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid status/sort/order/limit values and UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

status.description: Filter link types by metadata status.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of link types to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_user
tool_schemas.description: Resolves a Jira user by email within the specified connection and returns the matched user identity, including the Jira accountId when found. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if email is missing/invalid or connection_id fails format validation, and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if no Jira user can be resolved for the provided email in this connection.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

email.description: User email address to resolve to a Jira accountId.

tool_schemas.name: create_issue
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Jira issue in the given project using issue_type_id and summary, optionally setting description, assignee/reporter accountId, parent_issue_key (for subtasks), and additional Jira fields via fields_json, then returns the created issue record including its issue key. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, if fields_json is not an object, or if parent_issue_key is provided for a non-subtask issue type; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project_key, issue_type_id, parent_issue_key, assignee_account_id, or reporter_account_id cannot be resolved in this connection, and raises CONFLICT if the issue cannot be created due to an incompatible project/issue type combination.

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

project_key.description: Project key to create the issue in (e.g., PROJ).

issue_type_id.description: Jira issue type id for the new issue.

parent_issue_key.description: Parent issue key if creating a subtask.

fields_json.description: Arbitrary Jira fields payload to set at creation (mirrors Jira 'fields' object).

tool_schemas.name: create_issue_link
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Jira issue-to-issue link between inward_issue_key and outward_issue_key using the named link_type_name in the given connection, optionally attaching a comment, and returns the created link record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required inputs are missing/invalid (including identical inward/outward keys or invalid connection_id format), and raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller. Raises NOT_FOUND if either issue key does not exist or the link_type_name is not available in this connection, and raises CONFLICT if a link of the same type between the same two issues already exists or if the link is not allowed by Jira for the current issue states.

connection_id.description: Jira MCP connection id that scopes the Jira tenant and credentials.

link_type_name.description: Jira issue link type name to use when creating the link (e.g., "Blocks", "Relates").

inward_issue_key.description: Issue key on the inward side of the link (e.g., "PROJ-123").

outward_issue_key.description: Issue key on the outward side of the link (e.g., "PROJ-456").

comment.description: Optional comment to attach to the issue link in Jira.

tool_schemas.name: get_issue
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single issue by issue_key from the specified Jira connection and returns the cached issue record, refreshing from Jira when the local cache is missing or stale. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id or issue_key are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is not accessible for the caller; raises NOT_FOUND if the issue does not exist in Jira (or is not visible to the caller).

connection_id.description: Jira connection identifier to scope the request.

issue_key.description: Jira issue key to fetch (e.g., PROJ-123).

refresh.description: When true, forces a refresh from Jira before returning.

tool_schemas.name: update_connection
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Jira connection's mutable fields and/or transitions its lifecycle status, returning the updated connection record. Only transitions declared by the connection lifecycle are permitted (active↔disabled, active→error, error→active/disabled). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are malformed, if no updatable fields are provided, or if the requested status transition is not allowed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot manage the connection; raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if the update would violate restrict rules (e.g., attempting to remove required defaults while child rows exist).

status.description: New connection status (must be a valid lifecycle transition).

default_project_key.description: Default project key used when a caller does not provide project_key.

auth_secret_ref.description: Reference to stored auth secret material used to connect to Jira.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlements for this Jira MCP server, including the active connection context, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credential is presented.

connection_id.description: Optional connection identifier to verify/access-check; if omitted, the server reports the configured active connection.
